timecoded_text_to_speech.text: When you're growing up, your elders, your brothers, whoever it is, they tell your men don't cry.
Walking up and down these streets was no joke growing up.
You know, you're a member of a gang. There are certain things that you have to do for membership.
I was stealing, I was cheating. Just doing what I always had done.
And to be honest with you, we went in there just to kind of have fun.
The type of thing never realizing how I was going to pull us in and change our whole way of thinking and our mentality.
I don't ever remember as a child, ever someone saying, look, there is hope.
And because of it, because I lived without any hope, I lived the way I did.

youtube_description:
Web Site: http://theneighborhoodfilm.com
FB: https://www.facebook.com/theneighborhoodfilm

‘The Neighborhood.’ ‘The Barrio.’ ‘The Hood.’ Growing up here is no joke: you have people getting stabbed, you have people getting robbed. Gang life is all about surviving, belonging and hustling. But with all your friends dying around you, where do you go to find hope?
